data.long_meaning: The name Baldeb is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bal’ meaning strength and ‘Deb’ meaning God. This name signifies being as strong as a mountain and being a god in one's own right. The name Baldeb carries the meaning “Strong as a mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Baldeb usually hope their child will grow to embody strong as a mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
